title: Seven-color packing coloring conjecture for claw-free subcubic graphs
statement: Let $G$ be a claw-free subcubic graph. **Seven-color packing coloring conjecture.** The graph $G$ is $(2,2,2,2,2,2,2)$-packing colorable. The paper gives related packing-coloring results for claw-free subcubic graphs, but does not establish this seven-color assertion; it remains open.
source_name: Ayman El Zein and Maidoun Mortada, “Impact of local girth on the S-packing coloring of k-saturated subcubic graphs”, arXiv:2603.25113 (2026).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.25113

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of March 2026).
